summary: Added three ECS Fargate rules in the cfn-lint repo, nothing committed. E3052 (FargateNetworkMode): Fargate task definitions must use NetworkMode awsvpc. E3053 (FargateNetworkConfiguration): ECS services with LaunchType FARGATE must set NetworkConfiguration.AwsvpcConfiguration. E3054 (FargateExecutionRole): Fargate task definitions must set ExecutionRoleArn; this one is the most judgment-dependent and may false-positive on tasks that need no execution role. The issue #1547 text was not available offline, so the rule choice is my own reading of the spec. Each rule is a JSON-schema extension plus a rule class, with unit tests and docs/rules.md rows. Ref/Fn values are not flagged. Tests: ECS and rule-collection suites pass (85). Full unit suite: 1527 passed, 1 failed (test_build_graph, needs pygraphviz/pydot, not installed in the shared venv). test_formatters.py was excluded because defusedxml is missing from the venv. All runs used PYTHONPATH=<repo>/src because the venv imports cfnlint from a different checkout. No formatter/linter was run because none is installed in the venv.
